work.description: The singer's published introduction to a 1999 selection of the Psalms, which is the source of his own account of the song '40', U2's setting of Vulgate Psalm 39 - the psalm of the Offertory antiphon of the Fifteenth Sunday after Pentecost - and of the refrain grafted onto it that the psalm does not contain.
work.title: Introduction to Selections from the Book of Psalms
